hero.title: Your greenhouse climate, lighting and watering in one place
hero.subtitle: See what is happening in every growing zone and adjust its care. Try a ready-made farm with four greenhouses, plants and sensor history, right in your browser.
hero.preview_alt: GrowerHub demo farm: four greenhouses with climate, watering and lighting
hero.preview_caption: The real app with virtual devices. Your changes belong to your own demo farm.
hero.reassurance: No sign-up · No hardware · Free to try

demo_video.title: Watch watering in action
demo_video.heading: Try the same steps in your demo farm
steps: Choose a greenhouse, tap “Start watering” and set a duration of 1 minute.
Choose “Start” to see the timer and the stop button.
When watering finishes, the pump log opens automatically with the duration and calculated volume.
demo_video.note: A walkthrough using screens from the working demo. Devices are virtual and the water volume is simulated. Waiting time is shortened in the video.

secondary.title: Ready to connect your own greenhouse?
secondary.text: Keep your existing Home Assistant and Zigbee2MQTT setup. Connect it through a local bridge, check one sensor, then add devices and automations at your own pace.

points.title: What you need
points.text: A compatible Zigbee coordinator, a sensor and an always-on computer running Zigbee2MQTT. GrowerHub needs an internet connection.

points.title: What is free
points.text: The dashboard, sensor history and available automations are currently free, with no payment card required. Hardware is purchased separately.

points.title: Your first result
points.text: Readings and their freshness on one page. If the connection is lost, readings become stale and server automations wait for connectivity to return.

features.title: What would you like to try?
features.text: Choose a task. The demo will open the relevant part of the app.

items.title: Compare four greenhouses
items.text: See different temperatures and moisture levels. Tap a reading to explore its history.

items.title: Set up lighting and watering
items.text: Change a lighting schedule, climate thresholds or watering settings, then save your scenario.

items.title: Water a virtual plant
items.text: Choose a greenhouse, run a short watering session and see it appear in the history.

items.title: Keep a plant journal
items.text: Open “Journal” on a plant card, add an observation and download your records as Markdown.

title: Greenhouse monitoring and automation — GrowerHub demo
description: Monitor greenhouse climate, lighting and watering in one dashboard. Try four virtual greenhouses without signing up, then connect your own Zigbee2MQTT devices.

items.question: Do I need an account or any devices?
items.answer: No. The demo comes with virtual devices, plants, watering records and sensor history. It uses the same interface as a connected farm.

items.question: Can I change things in the demo?
items.answer: Yes. Edit scenarios, assign devices, add plants and try watering. Each visitor has a separate demo farm; its commands do not control physical hardware.

items.question: Will my changes be saved?
items.answer: A guest demo lasts 24 hours. Choose “Save demo farm” and sign in to keep it in your account and continue later.

items.question: What does GrowerHub cost?
items.answer: The dashboard, sensor history and available automations are currently free, with no payment card required. Hardware and an always-on computer for Zigbee2MQTT are supplied separately.

evidence.title: See how GrowerHub is built
evidence.text: The code, development history and a dated summary of operational data are public. The demo shows the interface and simulated behaviour; the project page explains the evidence from physical devices.

cta.title: Your demo farm is ready
cta.text: Open it, change a setting and see how the app works. Connect your own devices when you are ready.
